draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.69, the 216th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 6th of 9 at QB. He lasted until pick 241, well after his grade rank (216th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: 213. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 3,164 passing yards in 2021, 6th of 9 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 4 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons. His 2025 season (1 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (3rd percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-4 quarterback who played: 235 passing yards against a median of 1,389, below the norm.
